title: Pull the Pin Rescue
description: Slide golden pins in the smartest order to extinguish flames, neutralize monsters, drop treasure safely, and pull our heroine out of danger.
controls: Tap or pull pins in the right sequence so hazards cancel out and the character reaches safety.

zh-CN.title: 拔针帮她脱险
zh-CN.description: 买量点击率王者拔针帮她脱险：仔细思考插销拔出顺序，用水灭岩浆、用机关消灭怪物，顺利救出被困小姐姐！
zh-CN.controls: 点击拔出正确的金属插销，巧妙引导水流化解陷阱怪物，帮主角顺利脱险。
